_doc: Receipt-bearing overrides. ONLY for cases where a PROOF exists that the pipeline
cannot carry out algorithmically. Every entry MUST carry 'proof' -- an entry without
proof text is ignored by slice_verdict/four_genus_verdict. This is the only place
where a verdict may override the computed bounds; it is deliberately small,
hand-maintained and readable, so that it does not become a back door for claims.
KEYS (extended 2026-08-19): an entry may be keyed to the STEM of a record
(e.g. 'double-3') OR to the KNOT IDENTITY (e.g. '12a_1019'). Sliceness is a
property of the KNOT, not of the parametrisation -- an identity entry therefore applies
to all records with this distinct_knot_id. Order: stem beats identity.

proof: Identity (Disc #142/#557, anchor 1): knots-of-love = 3_1 # 3_1 # 3_1 # m3_1 # m3_1 # m3_1 (three right- and three left-handed trefoils = square knot three times; handedness corrected 2026-07-26, before that this said six times 3_1 -- det=3^6 and Alexander (t^2-t+1)^6 are chirality-blind, the proof stands three lines further down),
Alexander (t^2-t+1)^6 bit-exact, det 729 = 3^6, genus 6, not hyperbolic (vol ~ 1.5e-5).
HANDEDNESS (2026-07-23, Disc #557): Jones is multiplicative under connected sum AND
distinguishes mirror images. Factorisation against the trefoil from our own corpus
(celtic-trefoil) gives V = V_R^3 * V_L^3 -- of all seven splittings a+b=6 EXACTLY
THIS ONE fits. HOMFLY (stronger) independently gives the same 3+3. Additively confirmed:
sigma = 0, tau = 0, s = 0; a sum of six +- contributions is zero only for 3+3.
CONSEQUENCE: with K = 3_1#3_1#3_1 the knot is K # m(K). The trefoil is invertible,
so m(K) is the concordance inverse of K, and K # m(K) is always a RIBBON KNOT.
=> ribbon => slice => g_4 = 0 (smooth and topological).
=> amphichiral, because m(K # m(K)) = m(K) # K = K # m(K) (connected sum is commutative).
The stored is_amphicheiral=False came from snappy on a NON-hyperbolic knot
(vol ~ 0) and carries no meaning there.
Cross-check: all necessary slice conditions were satisfied anyway (sigma=tau=s=Arf=0,
det=729=27^2) -- the proof explains WHY instead of presuming it.
knots-of-love.source_public: Own result: the knot is K # m(K) with K = 3₁#3₁#3₁ (handedness fixed by Jones/HOMFLY factorisation against our own trefoil). K # m(K) is always a ribbon knot ⇒ slice ⇒ g₄ = 0.

proof: IDENTITY COMPUTED BLIND: 12a_1019 comes from our own .fseries chain (crosscheck_knotinfo), independently of the source cited here. What was looked up is a PROPERTY of an already identified knot -- hard rule 1 not violated.

RIBBON RECEIPT (literature, fetched 2026-08-19): Christoph Lamm, 'The search for non-symmetric ribbon knots', arXiv:1710.06909v2 (5 January 2019), Table 1: 'a list of all 137 prime ribbon knots with crossing numbers 11 or 12'. Receipt PDF: konversationen/slice_stand_20260818/. 12a1019 is in this list.
CONSTRUCTION (Lamm, appendix page 20, det=361 block): 12a1019 is the SYMMETRIC UNION with partial knot K_+- = 7_6 and axis parameters (1, -1).

DESIGN (Kinoshita-Terasaka 1957, Lamm Def. 6.1): a partial knot and its mirror image on either side of a symmetry axis, between them the central part C with twist tangles whose signed crossing numbers are (1,-1). Folding along the axis -- the diagram supplies the height function -- gives a band of constant width. By Aceto (Lamm Prop. 5.1) this band consists only of strips, ends, twists and RIBBON SINGULARITIES; it contains neither crossings nor junctions. Symmetric unions are therefore RIBBON by design.

INDEPENDENT CROSS-CHECK (2026-08-19, COMPUTED, not cited): for a symmetric union det = det(K_+-)^2. det(7_6) = 19, determined as the torsion of H_1 of the 2-fold cyclic cover (snappy, gnottheorie_env; method calibrated on the counter-case 4_1 -> det 5). 19^2 = 361 = our own determinant, computed blind. The cited construction reproduces our number by an entirely different route.
CONSEQUENCE: ribbon => slice => g_4 = 0, smooth AND topological.
The necessary conditions were all satisfied anyway (tau = s = sigma = Arf = 0, det = 361 = 19^2) -- the receipt explains WHY instead of leaving it open.

LIMIT, explicitly: this is a LITERATURE RECEIPT for a property of a blindly identified knot, NOT a disc we built ourselves. As long as we have not constructed and checked the band presentation by our own hand, Lamm is the source.
12a_1019.source_public: C. Lamm, The search for non-symmetric ribbon knots, arXiv:1710.06909v2 (2019), Table 1 and appendix p. 20: symmetric union with partial knot 7₆ and axis parameters (1, −1). Ribbon ⇒ slice ⇒ g₄ = 0. Cross-check: det(7₆)² = 19² = 361, matching our independently computed determinant.

proof: IDENTITY COMPUTED BLIND: the record 'mirror' was determined from our own .fseries as 5_2 # m5_2 (crosscheck_knotinfo, distinct_knot_id), independently of everything here.

STRUCTURAL ARGUMENT (no literature receipt needed): for INVERTIBLE K, K # m(K) is always a ribbon knot -- one folds the knotted band back onto itself at a plane, the fold IS the ribbon disc. For invertible K, m(K) is the concordance inverse of K, so K # m(K) represents the zero element.

INVERTIBILITY OF 5_2 COMPUTED (2026-08-19, snappy, gnottheorie_env): symmetry_group() = Z/2 + Z/2, is_invertible_knot() = True, is_full_group() = True (so COMPLETELY determined, not a partial result), is_amphicheiral() = False (5_2 is chiral, so m5_2 really is a different summand).

HANDEDNESS VIA THE CHIRALITY-SENSITIVE QUANTITY (lesson from Disc #557 / knots-of-love: det and Alexander are chirality-blind and must NOT carry the handedness): sigma is additive under connected sum. Computed (snappy+sage, Singular on PATH): sigma(5_2) = -2, sigma(m5_2) = +2. Hence sigma(5_2 # m5_2) = 0 = our record, whereas same-handed sigma(5_2 # 5_2) = -4 -- EXCLUDED. The mirror checker was calibrated beforehand on the trefoil (sigma(3_1)=+2, sigma(m3_1)=-2); a first attempt had silently measured WRONG because snappy .mirror() returns a NEW object instead of mirroring in place -- the calibration caught exactly that.

NUMBER CROSS-CHECKS, all computed independently and all passed: det(5_2)^2 = 7^2 = 49 = our record. Alexander(5_2)^2 = (2t^2-3t+2)^2 = 4t^4-12t^3+17t^2-12t+4 -- BIT-EXACTLY our stored '4 x^4 - 12 x^3 + 17 x^2 - 12 x + 4' (only regina's x instead of t notation, footgun 15). Genus 2 = 2 * genus(5_2) = 2*1, consistent.
CONSEQUENCE: ribbon => slice => g_4 = 0, smooth AND topological. All necessary conditions were satisfied anyway (tau=s=sigma=Arf=0, det=49=7^2) -- the argument explains WHY.

LIMIT: this is a STRUCTURAL argument from the construction, not a band presentation we built and checked explicitly. It is therefore better receipted than the Lamm cases (no outside receipt needed), but it does not replace the constructive branch.
mirror.source_public: Own result: the knot is K # m(K) with K = 5₂. We computed that 5₂ is invertible (SnapPy symmetry group Z/2+Z/2, full group), so m(5₂) is its concordance inverse and K # m(K) is a ribbon knot ⇒ slice ⇒ g₄ = 0. Handedness is fixed by the signature, which is chirality-sensitive: σ(5₂) = −2 and σ(m5₂) = +2 sum to 0, matching the record, whereas two same-handed summands would give −4.
